title: Reading raw Project Blue Book case files

tellings.quote: topic and I've read the the raw case files, the raw blue book case, like uh no analysis, just right, just the straight uh reports

plain: The raw case files of Project Blue Book, the US Air Force's UFO study of the 1950s and 60s, are worth reading as they are, with no one's analysis on top, says Marik von Rennenkampff, a writer and former Defense Department analyst who has read them himself. He says he has gone through "the raw blue book case, like uh no analysis, just right, just the straight uh reports," and he raises it to say that the original reports, read on their own terms, tell more than the Air Force's summaries.
